'''New Republic High Command''', or '''New Republic Command''' or '''Joint Command''', was an organ of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Inner Council (New Republic)|Inner Council]] in charge of its [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|military operations]]. [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] was made [[Executive Advisor]] of the High Command in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]]. It was succeeded by [[Galactic Alliance High Command]] in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]].
